title: Translation 翻译
paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
prompt: 元旦前夕，学校礼堂里举行了一场联欢晚会。师生们自己编排节目，有合唱、舞蹈，也有小品和乐器演奏。晚会开始时，校长发表了简短的新年致辞，随后屏幕上播放了一年来校园生活的照片。最受欢迎的环节是抽奖，幸运的同学得到了书和文具。午夜钟声敲响时，全场一起倒数，互相祝福新年快乐。这样的晚会不仅让大家放松，也让师生之间的关系更加亲近。
reference: On New Year's Eve, a gala was held in the school hall. Teachers and students put on the performances themselves, including a chorus, dances, short plays and instrumental music. At the beginning of the gala, the headmaster gave a short New Year speech, and then photos of campus life over the past year were shown on the screen. The most popular part was the lucky draw, in which lucky students received books and stationery. When the clock struck midnight, everyone counted down together and wished each other a happy New Year. Such a gala not only helps people relax but also brings teachers and students closer to each other.
